verified: The Financial Times reported that SpaceX and Tesla have entrusted five directors with negotiating the terms of a potential $3.5tn combination and are racing to complete a deal before the end of the year. Elon Musk said in October that the two companies were exploring a merger, the New York Times reported.
unconfirmed: The $3.5tn valuation, the all-stock structure, the assertion that all five directors have ties to Musk and the year-end deadline all rest on unnamed sources; neither company has confirmed a signed agreement, a board vote or a regulatory filing. The FT account describes a single group of five directors working out terms, while the headline refers to two special committees of five — leaving unresolved whether five directors are involved in total or five on each committee.

verified: 据《金融时报》报道，SpaceX 与特斯拉已将这笔潜在合并的条款谈判交给五名董事，并力争在年底前完成交易；《纽约时报》2026年10月21日的报道称，马斯克本人公开表示两家公司正在探讨合并。
unconfirmed: 交易能否最终达成、3.5万亿美元估值、全股票交易结构以及“年底前完成”的时间表，目前仅来自《金融时报》援引的匿名消息人士；两家公司均未公开确认，协议的具体条款、这五名董事为何被视为“无利害关系”以及他们的表决安排也都没有披露。Yahoo Finance 报道的投资者 Gary Black 对潜在股权稀释的批评，同样属于外部评论而非交易细节。

titles.en: SpaceX and Tesla in talks for $3.5T all-stock merger, FT reports
titles.zh: 消息称 SpaceX 与特斯拉洽谈 3.5 万亿美元全股票合并，《金融时报》报道
